groupPreallocate-helpText: Use this tool to search for organisations that are not yet present in GeoNetwork as a user group, yet are expected to be there for some reason. As groups are currently only created when users log in, this offers an alternative and safe way of circumventing the need for an organisation's users to log in before creating their records.
groupPreallocate-searchByNameLabel: Type (part of) an organization name to search the organization register (het Organisatieregister). The number of results is limited to 100.
groupPreallocate-searchByOvoLabel: Enter an OVO code to search the organization register (het Organisatieregister).
host.name: Hostname

By selecting {{groupName}}, you agree to manage the new record yourself. If you want to have support by the DataPublicatie team, select a DataPublicatie group instead.
